name: @sorenllm/opencode-computer-use
description: Desktop computer use for opencode via trycua/cua's cua-driver (MCP stdio): one consolidated `computer` tool (capture som/vision/ax + element-addressed click/type/key/scroll/drag), screenshots returned to the model as image attachments, semantic verdicts, hard-blocked destructive input, sticky-target guard, and a detect-degrade-instruct driver lifecycle — the plugin never installs or upgrades the driver; it probes locally and tells the user the exact command to run.
author: chengsongren
